user.title: Battery settings
user.description: Name this battery and choose the source for its Battery seasonal SOC min threshold. This first version exposes the shared threshold only; FBC forecast input and device control are not connected yet.

monthly.title: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold
monthly.description: Set one minimum SOC threshold per calendar month. Florian's values are editable suggestions; review them for your battery. FBC allows maximum charging power below this threshold. This setting alone does not prevent discharge.

existing_entity.title: Battery seasonal SOC min threshold
existing_entity.description: Select an existing sensor, number or input_number that supplies the current threshold in percent (unit %). It must currently have a numeric value from 0 to 100. Your entity manages any seasonal changes. An unavailable source makes the HA-BEMS threshold unavailable; there is no automatic fallback to the monthly schedule.

error.invalid_entity: Select an available entity with a numeric value from 0 to 100 and unit %. This is the threshold source, not the measured battery SOC.
error.self_reference: Select an external entity. This battery cannot use its own HA-BEMS output as its source.
